tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Graunt catalog of evaluated data packets. Returns matching packets with their id, title, and public URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one Graunt catalog packet by id. Returns its title, description, price and whether an account is needed, its seller-declared rights, and its public URL.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search the public catalog of evaluated packets and listings. Returns paginated matches.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Read a single listing by id. Public projection.

tools.name: get_agent_commerce_manifest
tools.description: Read the agent commerce manifest for a listing: price, rights, and how to buy it.

tools.name: get_bundle_manifest
tools.description: Read the per-asset bundle inventory: every delivered file with role, format, size and content hash, plus counts that name the population each one counted.

tools.name: meta_capabilities
tools.description: Read /v1/meta/capabilities — the authoritative capability state map.

findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: fetch, get_bundle_manifest · Public sink: meta_refinery_support_matrix · Destructive: get_bundle_manifest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: fetch, get_bundle_manifest · Public sink: meta_refinery_support_matrix · Destructive: get_bundle_manifest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
